verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a chat and community platform, so the axis applies. Every item in the evidence pack describes Discord as a hosted service: bots, apps and SDKs that run inside Discord, a REST API on discord.com, and a downloadable or browser client. None documents a way to deploy or run the core product on your own infrastructure, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
